column1: # What each cabin clip must produce downstream, one line per clip.
# device   window temp ac recirc fan rear_vents seat_heat seat_vent massage
# position fl fr rl rr, or - when the command does not name one. fl/fr are the
#          front seats: 主驾/驾驶位 and driver mean fl, 副驾/副驾驶 and
#          passenger mean fr, because this car is left-hand drive.
# state    on, off, or ? when the reference itself leaves the verb out
#          ("Only the rear right window.") and only the device is graded.
# value    - when the command does not set one; otherwise percent for window
#          and footwell, degrees Celsius for temp, a level for fan and seat
#          heat/ventilation, and warm_white for ambient colour.
# `none` means the clip must not become an actionable command at all: no
# device with a stated on/off state, in either language.
